description: IRVE statique (organisation DejaBlue) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DejaBlue. This dataset lists all public charging stations operated by DejaBlue in France. It includes a file in CSV format describing the geographical location of the terminals, their technical characteristics (power, available connectors), their operating status and accessibility information. Data is updated quarterly to ensure reliability and relevance. Coverage: DejaBlue. The portal shows the English title as "Static IRVE (DejaBlue organization)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DejaBlue. Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-10-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
